description:
Release the held pay of a hire to the worker. Final. Paying approves the work that waits for review.
Use for: paying a worker whose pay is held and whose submitted work you accept. The work is checked once, when the call starts. The reply says what this call released and where the hire stands; get_hire shows the whole hire.
Not for: asking for fixes (request_redo); refusing the work (reject_submission).
Needs: an API key. Hosted sign-in cannot call this yet.
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: pay_hire({"hireId":"a3Fh8kQz1WpL0mNc","submissionId":"s_7Hd2kQ"})
Repeat: Once this has worked, a repeat does not do it again while that result still stands: it is refused, or answers with what is already there.
Errors: not_payable, pay_later_not_supported, hire_kind_not_supported, bonus_decisions_required, bonus_decisions_saved, payment_sent_finishing; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

bonuses.description: Your decision on each bonus of a hire whose bonuses are still to decide. `bonus` in the reply is the bonus money this call released, and get_hire lists the decisions that stand in `submission.review.bonuses`. Default: none.

bonusId.description: Use bonusId from get_hire submission.bonusClaims or id from get_bounty bonuses. Choose a bonus funded for this hire.

earnedUnits.description: Whole items earned, from 0 to claimedUnits; for an unclaimed bonus, from 0 to maxUnits.

reason.description: Why you chose this count. Up to 500 characters after trimming. Leave out for no reason.

hireId.description: The hire id, from list_hires or accept_application.

submissionId.description: The submission you pay for: `submission.id` of the hire, from get_hire. When sent, the call is refused if the hire now shows another submission. Default: not checked.

name: pay_hire

actions.description: Tools you may call on this hire now. Each tool still checks. Left out when there are none, and when status is left out: then read the hire with get_hire.

bonus.description: The bonus money released to the worker with this payment. Left out when it is 0.

isCreditedToWorker.description: What the release reported. true: the worker's balance was credited. Left out (false): the pay left the hold and no credit to the worker's balance was reported yet.

payStatus.description: Left out only when the hire could not be read after this call: then status, payStatus and actions are all left out. Read it with get_hire.

status.description: Left out only when the hire could not be read after this call: then status, payStatus and actions are all left out. Read it with get_hire.

unusedBonus.description: The bonus money that was not earned. Left out when it is 0.

workerPay.description: The pay this call released for the worker: the hire's pay with the bonus money earned, not counting the service fee. It is in the worker's balance only when isCreditedToWorker is true. Left out only when the amount could not be read after the call.

title: Pay a hire
